sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your counter-offer and welcome the mutual stability that a 24-month contract provides. 

We are prepared to commit to this longer term; however, as a trade-off, we must set the payment terms to 45 days rather than the 60 days you requested. Our updated main Angebot stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €52.10 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our family-run foundry deeply values our long-standing relationship, and we fully expect our negotiations to progress constructively rather than backward.

Our position is firm, and our offer stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days. Our offer of €52.30 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms remains our firm position. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
